design.owner_goal: Protect margin: keep refunds as low as possible; we would rather sell fewer units than pay refunds.

bounds.floor_rule: 0.90 × agent store real price on D
bounds.ceiling_rule: 1.10 × agent store real price on D

design.unit_cost_rule: 0.80 × agent store real price on D (20% gross margin assumption; also reported at 10% and 30%)

conditions.a: Real price on D, no promise
conditions.b: Real price on D, promise cap = min(10% of price, ceil(expected_drop_usd))
conditions.c: Rule seller: undercut cheapest other store by $0.01 down to floor; promise cap = min(10% of price, expected_drop_usd) if p_drop × min(cap, expected_drop) < 0.25 × (price − unit_cost)
conditions.d: LLM sets promise cap once per day (price = real price) with nightly strategy memo
conditions.e: LLM sets daily price & cap, answers all 6 buyer messages in one batched call (personal price/cap within bounds or keep listing), and updates nightly strategy memo
